Webster Bank Trimmed Its Apple (AAPL) Position; Wisdomtree Investments Has 1.19 Sentiment 
March 21, 2018 - By Lawrence Diaz

The Webster Bank holds 96,755 shares with $14.91 million value, down from 100,928 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $889.17 billion valuation. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.06   $175.24. About 19.65M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   45.78% the S&P500. 
WisdomTree Investments, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as an exchange-traded funds sponsor and asset manager. The company has market cap of $1.31 billion. It offers ETFs in equities, currency, fixed income, and alternatives asset classes. It has a 48.4 P/E ratio. The firm also licenses its indexes to third parties for proprietary products, as well as offers a platform to promote the use of WisdomTree ETFs in 401(k) plans.

AAPL’s profit will be $13.75 billion for 16.17 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality.
